Figure 10.5 Image Description 
A chart depicts the amount of calories coming from carbohydrate and from fat depending 
on the intensity of the exercise. The cardio zone at a higher intensity uses more carbohydrate 
than fat compared to the fat-burning (lower intensity) zone, but the cardio zone also burns 
more total calories per hour.
